Provalus is actively hiring entry-level Healthcare Insurance Customer Support Representatives to support claims processing, member inquiries, and customer service activities for health insurance products. This is a great opportunity to start a career in the healthcare insurance industry, with accelerated career advancement opportunities for those who perform well.

THE JOB

Responsibilities include:


  • Learn and apply claims processing procedures, healthcare terminology, and company systems through structured, on-the-job training.

  • Research claims status, benefits, eligibility, and coverage details using available resources, CRM, and internal claims processing systems.

  • Handle and resolve member and provider inquiries related to claims processing, billing questions, coverage, and general customer service issues.

  • Provide members and providers with clear, accurate information regarding plan benefits and claims status.

  • Process claims-related forms and other member/provider requests accurately and within required timeframes.

  • Identify and escalate priority or complex issues to senior team members or management as needed.

  • Route inbound calls to the appropriate internal resources, including claims, billing, or clinical teams.

  • Follow up on more complicated member calls as needed, with support from senior team members.

  • Complete accurate call notes and claims documentation, updating records in the CRM and claims processing systems.

  • Gather and record relevant details from member/provider interactions, including comments, inquiries, complaints, and actions taken.

  • Maintain strict confidentiality of protected health information (PHI) and personally identifiable information (PII) in accordance with HIPAA and applicable regulations — full training provided.

  • Communicate and coordinate with internal departments (e.g., claims, billing, provider relations) as needed.

  • Ask questions and seek guidance from trainers, mentors, and team leads as you build your skills.

  • Other duties as assigned.

  • Must have an HS Diploma or GED.

  • No prior healthcare, insurance, or claims experience required — comprehensive training provided.

  • Willingness to learn healthcare terminology, basic medical billing/coding concepts, and insurance claims processes.

  • Ability to work onsite at the Provalus office. No remote positions are available currently.

  • Excellent communication skills, including verbal and written communication.

  • Ability to work well with others in a team environment.

  • Good computer skills and comfort learning new software/systems; ability to multi-task.

  • Willingness to learn and follow HIPAA and confidentiality requirements when handling sensitive information.

  • Strong attention to detail and a willingness to double-check work for accuracy.

  • Ability to stay calm, professional, and patient in stressful or fast-paced situations.

  • Coachable and open to feedback, with a strong desire to grow within the healthcare insurance field.

  • Paid, structured on-the-job training — no experience necessary to get started.

  • Clear path for career growth and advancement into more senior or leadership roles.

  • Supportive team environment with ongoing coaching and mentorship.

Job Type: Full-time Work Location: In person

• Maintain expert-level knowledge of client products, integrations, and value propositions

job.description:
SOC Tier 1 Security Analyst

Job Type: Full Time
Location: Onsite/Brewton, AL

Position Overview

This role is responsible for monitoring security events within a Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) platform, performing initial alert analysis and triage, managing event aggregation and correlation, and escalating potentially significant security events to the appropriate security operations teams.

The position operates within a 24 hours per day, 7 days per week, 365 days per year (24x7) security operations environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor security events and alerts within the customer's Google SecOps SIEM platform.
  • Perform Tier 1 alert and event triage, assessing alerts for relevance, severity, and potential security impact.
  • Review and manage aggregated security events to identify related activity and reduce duplicate or unnecessary tickets.
  • Perform initial event correlation to identify potentially related alerts and security activity.
  • Create and document security tickets based on identified events and established operating procedures.
  • Escalate security events requiring additional investigation or response to appropriate Tier 2/Tier 3 analysts or security teams.
  • Monitor and triage alerts generated by the customer's Web Application Firewall (WAF) and ingested into the SIEM.
  • Maintain accurate and timely ticket documentation, including relevant alert information, analysis, actions taken, and escalation details.
  • Help prevent unnecessary ticket sprawl by appropriately aggregating and correlating related events before creating individual tickets where practical.
  • Follow established security operations procedures, escalation criteria, and service-level requirements.
  • Support operational reporting and workload metrics related to event monitoring, triage, ticket creation, and escalation.

Preferred Skills and Qualifications

  • Experience in a Security Operations Center (SOC), cybersecurity operations, or security monitoring environment.
  • Understanding of common cybersecurity events, alerts, threats, and indicators of compromise.
  • Experience with SIEM platforms and security alert investigation.
  • Ability to analyze and prioritize security alerts based on severity and potential impact.
  • Familiarity with event correlation, aggregation, and escalation processes.
  • Strong attention to detail and documentation skills.
  • Ability to follow defined procedures while exercising sound judgment when evaluating security alerts.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a 24x7 operational environment, including assigned shifts, nights, weekends, and holidays as required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Google SecOps (formerly Chronicle).
  • Experience monitoring or triaging Web Application Firewall (WAF) alerts.
  • Familiarity with common SIEM concepts including log ingestion, normalization, correlation rules, alerting, and incident/ticket management.
  • Security certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CySA+, GIAC, or comparable credentials.
  • Familiarity with common security frameworks and SOC processes.

Work Environment

This is a 24x7 Security Operations Center role supporting continuous security monitoring. Candidates must be comfortable working an assigned shift schedule that may include overnight shifts, weekends, and holidays.
Job Type: Full Time 3rd Shift
Hours: Saturday - Wednesday 12AM - 9AM
Location: Onsite

As a Tier 1 SOC Analyst, you will serve as a first line of defense by monitoring security activity, identifying potentially significant events, documenting findings, and ensuring appropriate events are escalated for further investigation. Success in this role requires strong attention to detail, disciplined ticket management, and the ability to distinguish meaningful security activity from routine or duplicate alerts.

Provalus is seeking an Outbound Sales Supervisor, with 5+ years of relevant experience, including 2+ years in leadership, to oversee the day-to-day performance and development of 12–15 sales associates. The team conducts outbound B2B calls supporting a fintech company’s payment enrollment program.
Your role is to ensure your team consistently exceeds call volume, quality, vendor enrollment, and revenue targets, as well as resolving escalated vendor and client concerns.
This is a hands-on frontline leadership role: you will coach individual representatives, monitor and calibrate call quality, handle escalated and complex sales or payment-terms conversations, and serve as the operational and cultural anchor for your team, all while helping shape the scripts, SOPs, and workflows the broader team relies on.
All positions are full-time with set schedules, professional training and development, and opportunities for career advancement. Take the next step in your career today!
THE JOB
Responsibilities include:

  • Team Leadership: Directly supervise a team of 10–15 Outbound Sales Representatives, managing daily performance, productivity, lead/list assignment, and coverage.
  • Team achievement: Drive team achievement of daily and monthly sales quotas, lead-to-sale conversion rates, and incentive targets, holding representatives accountable to performance goals.
  • Coaching & Development: Provide regular coaching, feedback, and side-by-side call support to representatives; identify skill gaps and development opportunities, and support career progression from Representative I through II.
  • Quality Assurance: Conduct audits and quality reviews to confirm sales conversations are accurate, compliant, and effective; lead calibration sessions to align the team on messaging, pricing presentation, and objection handling.
  • Escalation Management: Serve as the escalation point for complex objections, strategic accounts, enrollment barriers, and payment-acceptance concerns that representatives cannot resolve independently.
  • Performance Management: Monitor team-level call volume, contact rate, enrollment conversion, quota attainment, revenue performance, and quality metrics; recognize strong performance and address performance gaps through timely coaching and corrective action. Performance metrics will include achievement towards monthly quota, conversion rates, revenue generated, and activities per hour.
  • Onboarding & Training: Support the onboarding and training of new hires, ensuring they are set up to succeed against scripts, product knowledge, CRM usage, sales best practices, SOPs, and quality standards.
  • Process Improvement: Identify recurring objections, competitive pressures, or process breakdowns within the team; recommend and help implement updates to scripts, SOPs, and knowledge base (KB) content.
  • Workflow & Scheduling: Manage day-to-day scheduling and workload balancing within the team in partnership with Workforce Management.
  • Reporting: Report on team performance, sales trends, and risks to leadership; contribute to broader program reporting and business reviews as needed.
  • Compliance: Ensure the team's sales practices consistently meet client policy and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Culture Ownership: Reinforce Provalus' mission and community-first culture within the team, fostering high accountability, performance-driven team culture with strong engagement, while maintaining professionalism and strong customer satisfaction standards

  • Ability to work onsite at the Provalus office. No remote positions are available currently.
  • 5+ years of high-volume outbound sales, telesales, or sales support experience, including experience at the Representative II level or equivalent.
  • 2+ years of experience leading, mentoring, or informally supervising others in an outbound sale or contact center environment (formal people-management experience preferred).
  • Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding team sales quotas and quality targets.
  • Excellent level of personal organization with superior telephone etiquette, verbal and written communication skills, as well as customer service skills are required.
  • Analytical and general math skills are required, including comfort reviewing pricing, payment terms, and performance metrics.
  • Experience conducting quality reviews/call audits and coaching others on sales technique and accuracy.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to give direct, constructive feedback.
  • Proficiency in the use of Microsoft Office product suite, including Excel and Outlook, are essential.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior formal supervisory or team lead experience in a contact center, BPO, or payment services/financial services sales environment.

  • Experience supporting payment processing, accounts-payable automation, vendor enrollment, or financial services client in an outsourced/BPO delivery model.
